remaining_delay_notes: Source IORTC wait maximum30s before root/userspace; RTC marker in next source measures it.
Current first GUI marker follows display-on but no logged physical power-key transition; source logs every debounced transition. Cannot attribute marker to physical press from display-on alone.
UFS command9.76064s and framebuffer4.82882s are concurrent aggregates, not additive critical-path time.
UFS lock-wait and strategy bounce memcpy are unmeasured. Command9.76064s includes DMA/cache/descriptor handling, with9.30755s doorbell wait.
No per-task runnable/CPU/wait accounting exists; cannot assign remaining interval to CPU userland or a specific service timeout.
Upcoming GUI retry/callback counters can distinguish consumed dirty frame from actual service/renderer delay.

Highest-value next optional measurement after RTC: common CNTVCT epoch markers at launchd exec, backboardd/SpringBoard exec, first accepted swap, first ownership success; aggregate UFS strategy memcpy and mutex wait, reported separately. Sum of per-caller mutex wait is contention exposure and may exceed wall time, not exclusive boot stall.
